headline: Turkmen State Commodity Exchange Records $3.2 Million in Polypropylene Trades
summary: The State Commodity and Raw Materials Exchange of Turkmenistan registered transactions worth 11.11 million manat ($3.2 million) on November 16. Deals centered on domestic polypropylene and export beverages.
why: Turkmenistan's state commodity exchange controls export pricing and sales of national natural gas derivatives and petrochemicals.

impacts.name: Turkmenistan
impacts.why: Petrochemical spot contract sales generate export revenue in foreign currencies.
